name: Kaze no Rondo
source:
In a militaristic nation main character completes the national education program. There is only one way forward for both boys and girls - to be separated from home and be sent to serve the nation. Only few days are left before the departure...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在一个奉行军国主义的国家，主人公完成了国民教育课程。无论男女，接下来都只有一条路可走：离开家乡，被派去为国家效力。距离出发，只剩下短短几天……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
